instruction: Use the opened OpenStudio application and its CLI/API automation interface to organize /home/user/Desktop/init.osm and save the updated model as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process OSM text outside the OpenStudio environment. The current model is a single-story showroom with the south side as the primary display face and the east and west sides as secondary facades. The architect wants the simple massing retained while the envelope and glazing performance are upgraded and summer direct sun is controlled with continuous south shading. Complete low-heat-transfer wall, roof, slab, and high-performance glazing constructions, along with showroom loads, outdoor air, infiltration, and comfort settings. Deliver only the updated OpenStudio model file; object handles, serialization order, and automatically generated metadata may vary naturally.
